name: AI Intern — mẫu đầy đủ
text:
Company: Lotus AI
Position: AI Intern
Location: Hanoi
Work mode: Hybrid
Experience: No professional experience required
Salary: 4-6 million VND/month
Required skills: Python, Git, pandas.
Preferred skills: SQL, Docker.
You will clean datasets and help evaluate machine learning models.

name: Backend Intern — thiếu lương và địa điểm
text:

Help the team build internal APIs.
